description: 2007 Sri Lanka Roads is a dataset listed in energydata.info, an open data portal for energy in developing countries under the section "Transport", published or maintained by World Bank Group (World Bank Group). Shapefile of national roads (Class A and Class B), digitized from Sri Lanka's National Road Master Plan. The road shapefile is topologically correct, i.e. ready to be used for a road network. Coverage: Sri Lanka. It has 2 files in SHP ZIP. The portal files it under Transport. The portal gives 2021 as the release date. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. Suitability for infrastructure simulation has not been checked. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-energydata-info-world-bank.
